column1: # The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening (update 1.1.0 = v131072, SDK 8.2.0) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Grezzo's engine on NintendoWare, NVN 53, lower-left window origin; 9,698 shaders from the bfsha archives, effects and layouts (game.tsv). Bring-up on the Retroid Pocket 6
# Its own text is drawn with the system's shared fonts (main imports nn::pl and ScalableFontEngine), which the host serves from the device's Roboto: no Hangul. For Korean, port with
# --shared-font <a TTF with Hangul>; Noto Sans KR (SIL OFL), made static at weight 400 and given the console font's OS/2 Windows ascent / descent (1158 / 378 per 1024 units of em),
# draws the file select at the console's size (a substitute's own metrics draw text about 1.5x too large: LASRecomp, runtime/hle/pl.c)
# The depth-of-field and tilt-shift blur (the top and bottom of the field blurred) is off by default (the user's choice, 2026-11-16). pfx_dof_composite_back
# (52fcbb4ca2a78907, postprocess.bfsha @0x2a6000) mixes the frame (binding 3) with two blurred copies (bindings 2 and 4) and writes the whole picture; given the frame in place of
# the copies (DM_VK_BIND_ALIAS) it writes the frame. Retroid Pocket 6, Mabe Village: edge variance of the top band 1,166 -> 3,263, bottom 431 -> 1,092, middle the same;
# frame rate unchanged (the passes still run). Checked docked, switched to handheld while running and started handheld (C:\d2rm\ports\lashot\alias-v1.png, c-hh-sw-on.png,
# c-hhcold-on.png; the off captures beside them). The game's own look again: a row "DM_VK_BIND_ALIAS=" (empty) in the device's env.txt, after the pack's rows (the app sets
# them in order; an install writes env.txt again, so add it after each), or "env DM_VK_BIND_ALIAS=" through DM_CTL while it runs. The community's "No DOF Blur" mod
# (MelonSpeedruns and Rodrigo, 2019) does the same by replacing postprocess.bfsha, whose shader keys the host's bundle would not match
env
# Retroid Pocket 6 (QCS8550, Adreno 740, Turnip T30), 2026-11-15: boot (7 cold starts after the main+0x1c16c cut, none crashed), opening and title movies (VP9 on c2.qti.vp9.decoder),
# file select in Korean, Mabe Village from a save at 40-52 fps with sound; 2026-11-16: a new game on an empty file to Marin and Tarin's house (Korean text, 59-60 fps, no [RED];
# naming the file writes its save at once), the title's dark frames in a 150 s screen recording are the movies' own (the same frame for frame in both loops of 119.2 s).
# Left: the field's frame work is one game thread at 100% (frame work p50 17-19 ms); black slivers at grass tips and a fluorescent map on its first opening reported by the
# user, not reproduced here (the c9da25e uniform fix is in)
# The rate is held at 60, not adapted: the field's frame work sits at the period (p50 16.9 ms on the Retroid Pocket 6), so the adaptive rate stepped down to 40 and back
# all session, which the player saw as the frame rate jumping. The pause menu's Frame rate limit (settings.txt rate=) still wins: its Auto is this pin (front_android.c rate_apply)
env
# The GPU at its highest clock (DM_GPU_TURBO, perf_android.c). The game waits for each frame's GPU work before it submits the next, so the GPU idles while the frame is
# replayed and reads about 74% busy, and its governor keeps it at 401 of 680 MHz: 8.1 ms of GPU work, and frames of 33 ms whenever game + replay + GPU passed the period.
# Retroid Pocket 6, its normal performance mode, docked, Mabe Village, 10 minutes each: without it the 10 s windows' p90 went past 30 ms in 18 of 58, with it in 0 of 64; the
# hottest CPU zone 49-50 °C without, 51-53 °C with (+2.2 °C on average; fan at 100%). Not measured: the battery drain (it was charging). Off: a row "DM_GPU_TURBO=0" after
# the pack's in env.txt, or "env DM_GPU_TURBO=0" through DM_CTL. The setting is the device's: the app gives it back in the background and at its end, and sets its own at
# the start; a force-stopped app leaves it on until the next start (perf_android.c)
env
status
tested
